summary: A short wiki note about Marmaduke Pickthall, stating that he was buried in the Muslim section of Brookwood Cemetery in Surrey, England. The note also records that Abdullah Yusuf Ali was later buried in the same section. The note is very brief and gives no biographical detail beyond the burial location.
one_line: Marmaduke Pickthall was buried in the Muslim section of Brookwood Cemetery in Surrey, England, where Abdullah Yusuf Ali was later interred.
